Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Elementary teachers annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education ($102,920). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $102,920, Chicago $78,390, Austin $61,270. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Elementary teachers?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education (45,840 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 45,840, Seattle 14,560, Austin 8,450. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Elementary teachers most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Chicago has the highest published location quotient (1.14). Published LQs: Chicago 1.14, Seattle 0.78, Austin 0.73.

Does OEWS publish hourly pay for Elementary teachers?

Not in this slice. OEWS May 2025 does not publish hourly mean or median for Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education in Austin, Chicago, or Seattle. WageGrid does not convert annual wages to hourly.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
